deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI humanoid robot "Astra" (with Telexistence) for store deployment
Conversational AI recruiting assistant 'Rita' automates candidate application, screening and interview scheduling for high-volume store hiring (7-Eleven Inc., US). [Paradox]
deployments_detail.value: 40,000 hours/week saved; 85% of applicants scheduled within an hour; time-to-hire cut from 10 days to under 5

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered Technician's Maintenance Assistant (RAG + vector search + vision models on Databricks Agent Bricks, surfaced in Microsoft Teams) that gives store maintenance technicians instant access to manuals, diagrams and part identification. [Databricks (Agent Bricks) / Microsoft Teams]
deployments_detail.value: up to 60% reduction in documentation search time; 25% improvement in first-time-fix rate; 40%+ lower latency

deployments_detail.use: Seven-Eleven Japan's AI ordering/demand-forecasting system that calculates optimal order quantities from past sales, weather forecasts and day-of-week data to reduce stockouts and speed up store ordering. [in-house]
deployments_detail.value: ~2,000 yen higher sales per store per day; order time reduced ~30 minutes daily

deployments_detail.use: Partnership with Telexistence to develop 'Astra' generative-AI humanoid robots (Vision-Language-Action foundation model) to handle routine in-store tasks across SEJ's store network. [Telexistence (with AIRoA)]
Telexistence 'Ghost' AI-powered beverage-restocking robot already in use in Seven-Eleven Japan stores, with a connected data-collection platform. [Telexistence]
Generative AI used in product planning to auto-generate texts and images for new products based on store sales data, speeding up the development of new merchandise. [in-house / undisclosed]

Sony edge-AI (IMX500 intelligent vision sensor, AITRIOS platform) deployed to measure digital-signage advertising effectiveness in stores - counting viewers and view duration without capturing identifiable images. [Sony Semiconductor Solutions (AITRIOS / IMX500)]

Multi-agent GenAI creative assistant for marketing (campaign creative generator, copywriter bot, supervisor agent) built on LangGraph + Databricks Mosaic AI, in production across marketing teams (7-Eleven Inc., US). [Databricks (Mosaic AI) / LangGraph]
Microsoft Azure AI services integrated into the 7NOW delivery app to provide personalized product recommendations to customers (7-Eleven Inc., US). [Microsoft Azure AI]
AI avatars (remote operators appearing on register screens) assist customers in multiple languages, with one operator covering multiple stores, trialed to address labor shortages. [undisclosed]
deployments_detail.value: combined measures expected to cut daily labor needs ~30%

deployments_detail.use: "AI Library" generative AI foundation (13 LLMs, Google Cloud) company-wide; used for product development
deployments_detail.value: ~8,000 employees by Aug 2025; product planning up to 90% time reduction
